verdict.rationale: Rive documents an official MCP connection to the Editor whose tools let AI create View Models, State Machines, Layouts and Shapes. It also documents RML, a text format for creating and modifying Rive files with coding agents, and a CLI that lets an agent generate experiences, so agents can write designs, not just read them. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent write workflows, detailed documentation of the MCP tool set beyond a 'first set of tools' (scope, modify/delete coverage), and a write-capable HTTP API (probes found no Rive API spec).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create or modify designs programmatically — through a write-capable API, plugin surface, or MCP tools — not just read them

citations.quote: The first set of tools are designed to let AI handle repetitive tasks, like creating complex View Models, State Machines with hundreds of states/layers, Layouts, Shapes, and more.
It lets you create and modify Rive content as code, making it possible to build Rive files with coding agents and other text-based workflows instead of working exclusively in the Editor.
let an agent generate them with the CLI
official MCP server documented at https://rive.app/docs/editor/ai/mcp
